match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett applies a quick lipstick touch-up using her phone's dark reflection. Framing: medium close-up, eye level, Scarlett stands against pale sky and glass towers, with rooftop grasses in the foreground and the coral lipstick held prominently near her face. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett stands beside the rooftop wall holding the opened lipstick, wind lifting loose strands of her hair while her phone is ready in her other hand. Camera, as one or two arrows: orbit, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Female, 20s, A sharp-eyed young woman of medium height, A sleek black turtleneck with a streamlined black-and-neutral. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
